title: dendrosenecio johnstonii subsp. cheranganiensis
intro: Dendrosenecio johnstonii subsp. cheranganiensis, commonly known as Cherangani Giant Senecio, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dendrosenecio johnstonii subsp. cheranganiensis include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. However, limited research is available on the bioactive constituents of this plant, making further study necessary to confirm its potential health benefits and mechanisms of action.
